name: party
note: Volvox party piece: the arm idles through a library generated for this stage and, on a trigger (TouchDesigner, OSC), plays a sequence or sweeps an LED strip across UV paper. Edited by hand or by the Houdini show scene. The canvas and the scan are PLACEHOLDERS until the paper and strip are decided (the canvas is the plane of the user's cat curve).

rest.note: the stage home; dance phrases (anticipation, overshoot, follow-through, breathing)

greet.note: the tool looks at the audience; gestures and spatial paths

canvas._note: 1.5 m wide x 1 m high UV paper, landscape, behind a 67 x 46 in (1.70 x 1.17 m) wooden frame whose 5.25 in rails overlap its edges (opening 1.435 x 0.902 m); rail depth in front of the paper 0.02 m estimated -- measure. Centre 1.30 m: under the ceiling's sprinkler with room to spare (the strip's top 1.80 m in the scan); scanned once, left to right from the robot's side (user, 2026-09-28). Moved 0.3 m towards the robot from the cat curve's plane so the whole scan line is reachable with the tool level.

scan._note: One pass, left to right as seen from the robot's side, crossing the frame's opening at speed_mps (ramps over the rails); the LED face led_gap_m from the photochromic canvas (the rails stand 0.02 in front of it, margins.scan_canvas_m clear of them). 0.2 m/s is the fastest this frame fits the work zone -- a travel speed: write at 0.02-0.05 m/s with show_stream --scan-speed 0.1-0.25 (the window's Scan speed), after a swatch test (docs/uv_scan_exposure.md).

audience.note: where people stand: outside the left partition, out of reach (placeholder)

greet.note: where the TCP performs for them

range._note: the show's operating range: the directions the arm may face (J1), the TCP's height band, the fraction of the measured limits clips are made at
